result: Tracking the gradient through same-sample differences along the path (SPIDER) finds ε-stationary points with O(min(n^{1/2}ε^{−2}, ε^{−3})) stochastic gradients, matching a lower bound for finite sums.
result_plain: SPIDER variance reduction: O(ε^−3) online, near-optimal n^{1/2}ε^−2 for finite sums.
